Review Focus Bear?

Reviewers mostly say Focus Bear helps them stay on task by blocking distracting sites, guiding routines, prompting breaks, and improving follow-through on reading, meetings, and daily planning. Several users, including people managing ADHD or bipolar symptoms, describe better focus, lower stress, and more structure once they learn the system. The main complaints are practical: setup can feel confusing, schedules and notifications need polish, and some users report serious reliability and account-access problems, including editing failures, paywall issues, and poor support response.

results.title: Features – What Focus Bear Can Do for You
results.content:
How breaks help

Working non-stop for hours on end is a recipe for eye strain, neck pain and headaches. You’ll probably also not be particularly productive. Focus Bear lets you set up break reminders that will soothe your eyes, stretch your body and improve your energy levels.

‍

We recommend taking a break every 20 minutes, looking away from your screen and stretching your body. Doing a short burst of exercise (a microworkout) during the break can help boost your energy levels and improve your fitness.

‍

Doing sets of pushups aren’t everyone’s cup of tea so feel free to customise Focus Bear to do breaks your way. Some gentle stretching or deep breathing may be just what you need.

‍

‍ [...] ‍

In the morning, Focus Bear will guide you through each of your habits one at a time.

Sample Morning Routine Start Screen

Sample Morning Routine Habit Activity

‍

As well as having a powerful morning routine, you’ll probably want to have a wind down routine in the evening. That’s possible too.

## Take productivity- ‍boosting breaks.

### Take breaks every 20 minutes - your brain and body will thank you. Detects when you're in hyper-focus and chooses a good time to suggest a break. It also auto-detects meetings so you don't get asked to do breaks when you're on a call.

How breaks help [...] ‍

‍

If you’re into quantified self, you can track metrics during breaks - e.g. after a break activity, “Drink water”, you can track “How many glasses of water did you drink?”

‍

‍

If you’ve ever used other break reminder apps, you might’ve been annoyed by their tendency to interrupt you at the worst possible times: you’re in an important meeting, sharing your screen when a break reminder comes up. “Not now!” We’ve got you covered - Focus Bear detects when you’re in a meeting and won’t show break reminders until you’re done.

Focus Bear Home Page

FocusBear is an innovative productivity app specifically designed for people with ADHD and ASD, developed by a team with personal experience in neurodivergence. The app aims to reduce decision fatigue and distraction by guiding users through their daily routines with real-time habit guides, blocking distracting sites and apps across all devices, and utilizing AI to maintain focus. Key features include personalized habit routines, productivity-boosting breaks, customizable focus modes, and automatic goal tracking. The app supports users in establishing healthy morning and evening routines, enhancing productivity at work, and ensuring quality time for relaxation and sleep.
